    {"concern_id":"piece.3.d000f774f23261b8ab4a8a8c","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.fb365314ccf2aedc483f903d8a8a21dea0d2f91fb1ffad903e29b5c575390388"]}],"rationale":"The VASP explanation is expressly current to the source edition and refers to Schedule 3B.     {"concern_id":"piece.3.c7524aec6581812dee9c92b1","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.544d8f820cc61b3958470c95a4d4d379983540dee263019d3553a210417b6eda"]}],"rationale":"Footnote marker 3 links account terminology to its definition, without identifying the second duty.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.245c61a483cbad201085b742","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.560d340d5d93829f83036938dcf53139c4145627940c183cb1556e81e6a430e9"]}],"rationale":"The interchangeable account terms apply for this circular. They do not establish a gift rule or a performance test for the unspecified second duty.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.bac5019d91332c220ba6ad39","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.9be7d63e901c83bfea9e59e078a525ff3469c198c8c92dd6815218730e20433b"]}],"rationale":"Footnote marker 4 must remain linked to the device-binding definition; it is not an independent obligation.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.f96664b9c39be32071bd238b","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.2b872fc3d59f63bfea3e6043615508528ad34b6e02d5560bc0fc92be51c45a71"]}],"rationale":"Device binding is one authentication factor based on securely enrolled device attributes. Its definition alone proves neither adequate verification nor performance of other duties.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.ef23575fb659757c88839a52","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.9a8aa931e598e9008e9aab082e1a2c5e23c930d1e73cc45da5e95fe0e76a583b"]}],"rationale":"Footnote marker 5 links background phishing statistics; it cannot resolve either original question.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.9c4961e10c794956539ae310","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.f33cabdb5ece92c0afcf365b455e5c421b9b7563881b78c0553e423189b2608e"]}],"rationale":"The 2025 phishing statistic supplies background, not an authentication performance threshold or evidence that a duty was performed.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.93d17662e05857cb9668299f","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.bd4e90e3054aa21e76e8ab473f0cf2721ce94c581443052c9780f0eec9ef3af9"]}],"rationale":"Footnote marker 6 points to external circulars; their substantive requirements cannot be inferred from the marker.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.061c2c025dd4ef5d84af1e0e","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.df18825bc70ae18308caff6e3ce27d6ce7bc9b41df460b04a7f6f87c2c764249"]}],"rationale":"The May and June 2025 circulars are referenced but their full text is absent. Their requirements and edition relationships remain dependencies.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.018be4244cc9d278cd93a67e","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.986ddaffb00feec023be9128b3f12dcfa98759d05d2ac7bd2d786204faac4a96"]}],"rationale":"Footnote marker 7 connects the registration provision to the bound-device definition; the existing-device exception remains applicable context.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.de0ceb965c0a6966125f64dc","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.754f1731022473958a81bae01b06c50a41f992683ebf032b47077c32bb3b0d4e"]}],"rationale":"Successful registration and linkage define bound devices. This does not impose rebinding on existing clients or establish that verification controls are robust.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.c4901ec6452c78f3e82f9b41","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.64f2afdf19a56534f3e242b86f283868d266ef87efd0a8bda52e7e0dc34da071"]}],"rationale":"Footnote marker 8 links platform examples to the contextual assessment requirement; it provides no standalone decision rule.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.4.bcc50fe7deff51a3c6165f32","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.14c31dfc2853b2f4499fa695b85792919395556151d767abe9bf17f3cd059d8f"]}],"rationale":"Desktop applications, mobile applications and websites are typical platforms. The examples do not remove the need to assess platform-specific risks and appropriate authentication.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.4.5671ab73fa5731d13cd0d88a","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.eebf8c16482a79a9f86c6db047f6682eade7ba51d451d688d0525530852f8a47"]}],"rationale":"Footnote marker 9 preserves the September 2020 circular dependency without supplying its contents.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.4.a5a5e634f6cb90e488f387c4","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.97dc96f3e4563d61a4be9c29b029763343c62ee9b8646886e49bfc97dcf2c3a8"]}],"rationale":"Section A of the September 2020 circular is identified, but its full requirements and interaction with this edition remain unverified.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.4.0ba6439ba19f56a9bfe47ed5","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.f61b5c2ea8e0a4d9e86ce373387a6a2287ef82338cf798f97d6a52017f797664"]}],"rationale":"Footnote marker 10 preserves the February 2025 circular reference and does not independently establish a duty.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.4.b9cc4a63ebeae0fc2eb60567","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.4f8e6564f8392582230c8692b3ed044494dfd056db0ae34cbed25625d57996d7"]}],"rationale":"The February 2025 circular is identified by title and date only. Its substantive requirements cannot be imported without the missing text.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.4.5419b9343a3749fb2344031d","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.c46f76b36c91e47572e95f8499b09948c1c25ee74ea94b5eed2b7d7b3baafa9c"]}],"rationale":"Footnote marker 11 links international recognition examples; it does not supply technical acceptance criteria.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.4.9d25082c5c1848a912af14e7","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.0bf3f9467d8907ea4c75a8626dbeca2dde699a0cc8b1d677ae48d6d42be50686"]}],"rationale":"Named international authorities support the source's recognition statement, but their standards and versions are not supplied. Recognition alone does not demonstrate implementation adequacy.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.4.03ff0454675dc4a673200abc","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.2f918a1b6138dc1f693ae76a828fede124736eaee6a2fea8f800f030bcc31b07"]}],"rationale":"Footnote marker 12 links two-factor authentication to external guidelines; that dependency remains open.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.4.aba427be983649f1a203fabe","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.e28c131010445dd64507560bc93fa9c52dd254baf848c7db0a14c3f34d68e458"]}],"rationale":"The cited Cybersecurity Guidelines and VATP Guidelines provisions are not reproduced. Their full two-factor requirements cannot be replaced by a single possession-factor check.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.4.848e4efa403504fe2ada9568","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.79d57afea65e8fef618f6848037f1a027b651024d4032634b74d5ca9b6b5ae94"]}],"rationale":"Footnote marker 13 preserves the external basis for passkey and device limits, including contextual qualifications.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.4.c126cf24350a71f22731ad65","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.d0b500078c32130b28304fce343151ce301a149a465a7addd8af30630090603c"]}],"rationale":"The September 2020 circular and FAQ answer 6, updated 31 May 2024, are external dependencies. The general three-item limits and assessment route for larger requests must not become absolute caps.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.4.ba1f4a277607f3e093994f0e","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.086610158140f2641ff2d6a01e37bfd49f48538ff1c516ffc9899ac53a8089ce"]}],"rationale":"Footnote marker 14 links session-timeout expectations to an external section; it does not settle their full meaning.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.4.c3de3efbd4989a820b6c3430","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.e4f3d893eff7ef8dc61bf682ad40ab45365fa4736be8c5d942bb139e6bf7ad83"]}],"rationale":"Section D of the September 2020 circular is absent. The supplied timeout example and conditional longer-timeout route remain distinct from an unconditional numeric rule.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.4.55899536d6c36881e38afbfa","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.ba79170b1e2e11830ba764a469d2452e76426f2fcee3a173672edd7bba3b6028"]}],"rationale":"Footnote marker 15 preserves the cybersecurity FAQ dependency for timeout controls.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.4.c40e68935dfd81b9aa067d71","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.36881e36a5cf6015e9efe1b6f6d28b66656568778db17c090b2910faa07703db"]}],"rationale":"FAQ answer 10 is referenced but not supplied. Its content and applicable edition remain unresolved.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.4.8d7e3b554d34e5ffa2fe56cb","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.1fcfe78d0973a9c38620dfd40456b324d2435a659af0989a98926ef87bf2086b"]}],"rationale":"Footnote marker 16 links monitoring expectations to external provisions and cannot establish their satisfaction.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.4.e3e4942f059daa57eb16e3f7","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.f5b7f6597c04b9d1031e3f163a43858a783a9ea5deb02ed493e5bf50a6c78b52"]}],"rationale":"Three external monitoring sources are identified. Monitoring and surveillance remain separate duties whose full requirements and performance are not resolved by authentication checks.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.4.976290790cfd3b74d8e58c63","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.689903aec2789448be2015da790e12180fe613a14ed3e5d12a1f07f7fdc60dd3"]}],"rationale":"Footnote marker 17 preserves reporting dependencies without specifying whether the second duty refers to reporting.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.4.77b52be0791e116e30756fac","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.c5d897298242b4e8682865a5a609dcbb76f9ae37beddef6e35d452c95936ce67"]}],"rationale":"The Code of Conduct and VATP reporting provisions are external dependencies. Immediate incident reporting remains separate from authentication implementation.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.4.ed693f7745949778cc44eb99","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.a726eddfab46ffb02dab2a1b0281662bef5ece3cc61fb7da812e041e5eb3975d"]}],"rationale":"The appendix heading connects the examples to the circular; it supplies no independent duty and does not resolve the question mismatch.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.5.18d13703f3c51219b052ce76","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.55270c9a9758c2109eefe1b517f020316d3022233f4eab2bbe4745c1a34bfe43"]}],"rationale":"The English address is publication furniture, not evidence of performance or an authentication exception. The synthetic concern remains unresolved.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.5.48e4941711ffec16b501369c","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.ad7100d841c382e3ca16cad50e699551b7f8098c5e249c6b1ab3210838f07dd6"]}],"rationale":"The Chinese address supplies publication context and no independent decision rule for either question.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.5.acc7d4d49975160ea284fcc3","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.562b70914520c156f3dccc51319330e4413fdb6d2bc6b198d37d5c027fd96490"]}],"rationale":"The telephone number and website are contact details; they do not authenticate the edition or establish duty performance.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.5.3f71fcbd4b4be933482068b9","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.8e75f86b27affdc58e8ec41e535b8791424b70190e9943826069743316e7402a"]}],"rationale":"Pagination helps preserve appendix continuity but does not supply a substantive obligation or resolve edition uncertainty.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.5.6c4f5245da230cb7d33f2563","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.b98ad9f9ad854987f84a73a8af5b9e43e91c10cc46c5b599acd206f1ecf92468"]}],"rationale":"This title fragment introduces examples of acceptable authentication methods and must be read with the next unit. It does not make the examples exhaustive.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.5.5e0881c8fc45f42d8e65acaa","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.3cf31c0feaa72c1fb1d2876cd2d45fb6153ea926a20bfe98088069e55867750b"]}],"rationale":"This continuation completes the appendix's phishing-risk title. It supplies no standalone test of robustness or performance.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.5.c5aa4303bc97dfc760c718dd","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.bfdc2697d7e6f769b7f28e142c5831400782a4695100445e330dc0acb0379638"]}],"rationale":"The passkey section heading does not mandate passkeys exclusively or displace device-binding alternatives.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.5.acf0458728b4d7fefd719630","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.f6500a0e0eec82f4c3098052858012aabbbbbf65b07950532656ce79b982f2fd"]}],"rationale":"The passkey description continues into the next unit, which makes adoption permissive. This fragment cannot establish mandatory exclusive use.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.5.caca3ecc8bcd7d180384be7a","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.094766ca9286c1f3f8a681ba90a38bfd71be821e0c363958cbfa538ef9e78582"]}],"rationale":"Passkeys are an available way to strengthen login security. Permissive adoption does not waive the applicable implementation standards or other duties.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.5.ef53dcaac6b331b843633d03","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.8049df609405a8229b70859cfa1de9ecbad27b5f84e83189823cf8d49a970199"]}],"rationale":"The public-key cryptography description begins a multi-unit explanation, not a complete acceptance or performance predicate.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.5.a2924c31faa97eaa159fe27a","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.272959c2f12a9dc77212a3abbf428374c5c3aa6bc67c08d29d33e84d98d398e2"]}],"rationale":"The storage description spans device, hardware key and passkey-manager alternatives across adjacent units. Storage location alone does not establish adequate implementation.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.5.c01cae7a5ace272d7cc59aee","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.8053164637311f40b39317bee054a317e29ef9b416a38df07a962802364b4779"]}],"rationale":"This continuation distinguishes client-side passkey storage from the firm's public-key storage. It cannot independently answer the second-duty question.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.5.1a7a8de83e6c55550a518c0c","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.fd9c6308e267fa197dd96124dd4559a11cf594acaee3286ac0dffef7cf037ec5"]}],"rationale":"The public key verifies logins and the source describes risk reduction. That explanation is not evidence that a particular implementation satisfies all standards.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.5.c26e29e48a2db5f8785bd8b4","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.3802ac147914b78027982de02a6690e50f10f3f22699b8fb86edf3b65889d5a8"]}],"rationale":"The listed credential threats continue the passkey design explanation. They do not supply measurable performance criteria or proof of duty completion.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.5.ad8dc7632b76d55b415affac","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.0cd1eb675b36b85728967372a39cce763d5f0e5df374e99df2137e5a0d23c6a5"]}],"rationale":"This final word completes the preceding account-takeover explanation and carries no independent obligation.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.5.f5670dbcbf11d1a150cfb668","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.a918f91af1daeb396850a770cc6833f2526917f4ed4a2abfafcef77266be8672"]}],"rationale":"The phishing-resistance explanation depends on linkage to the genuine site or application and its following qualifications; it is not an overall-compliance fact.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.5.679fc9d6dd9d95f5453f6310","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.0e0c06542e20346b6c5e09055624c917016536d33cfd5d95ec91e2d9e83806c6"]}],"rationale":"Site-specific passkey use continues the design explanation. Actual correct implementation and performance remain unestablished.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.5.70802369ab121712bb065241","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.77ccc7685ebde77c74d22506890351d36af3f9d6eee47621d60e3c6b303274dc"]}],"rationale":"This fragment introduces a redirection scenario whose consequence appears in subsequent units; it cannot be treated as a standalone condition.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.5.8459472e118c5632b2aff190","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.8639cd7c4d04f6e64a3c762671da6338123e4ddcd9efc13f10acad58fe210220"]}],"rationale":"The fraudulent-site scenario explains origin-specific authentication. It does not establish immunity from all account compromise or satisfaction of separate controls.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.5.ba1b65b59dd9c21a9ccf8a78","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.4175afa134e62ce8013a7b0fa912c4ae2779fe6b645a814633cac33fa77e0f5b"]}],"rationale":"The stated prevention consequence belongs to the preceding phishing scenario. It cannot replace certification, enrolment, recovery, monitoring or response requirements.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.6.5e71bd8e166222440935894e","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.650284a9b9fc919583d8283a0d327b8ed4c303f04549b49daa14aecf7f3fbec7"]}],"rationale":"The implementation-standards heading introduces subsequent requirements but does not itself define the second duty or an executable test.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.6.2b765ff934daf7a47706ba4b","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.a0df0e0a729d66abe13ddfa66b512e18a0b0ec15736bba49365dc276971cf036"]}],"rationale":"Third-party provision is one permitted implementation route. The sentence continues into the in-house alternative and shared certification expectation.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.6.42809ebd119b9c41eb4de231","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.cfda2768745403a8ba392fadab557bfa56831b95e6b49e9da3ba459f1fafc68a"]}],"rationale":"Both third-party and internally developed solutions remain subject to the following certification expectation. Neither route alone demonstrates compliance.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.6.19c43e9e23605f1ff5bb5701","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.d408bc7fd60d580cd97eae64c6f2ae0de8223ea53d8f0998b299c43d9c7c8183"]}],"rationale":"FIDO certification is specified, but the relevant certification scope, version and implementation evidence are absent. Certification alone does not account for all duties.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.6.c6cdad8659cedfa49f02a6b2","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.b68783ce429d2d02cd67e8567aca7df3488d6168463279f2248ac500775a2ed1"]}],"rationale":"The introductory should governs the following list. Its modality must remain attached to the substantive requirements, without assigning an unspecified second duty.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.6.38e803ac5ac5de8e1af04cae","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.4a1a3c051cf8c566e86de4b4cd66d6d8b4bb65972e26ed9eeea4c5168dadb596"]}],"rationale":"Strong identity verification is expected for passkey registration and setup. Its adequacy requires judgment and cannot be inferred from a passkey's mere existence.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.6.81c6890abd7ae5aff519dc40","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.5b688fbe624df66f3f4d1afc33ebc6020c506e035b868e1de07258e545db8034"]}],"rationale":"Additional-passkey creation is conditioned by the following authentication and authorisation language; this fragment alone omits essential prerequisites and alternatives.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.6.53db646aa12f7233938d75a3","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.207ac056ea94b42a3baaedd642b93856597d8f989c7ae73bc3b8a657e77e938c"]}],"rationale":"Authentication and authorisation must precede additional-passkey creation, using an existing registered passkey or the alternative completed in the next unit.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.6.ee15a725247e135aaf38ddcd","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.3698b9894f7f2f8e1d6ceec7f01490cb6b0f34113dcc4c47d1f78e8c46f1b7da"]}],"rationale":"Other robust verification controls remain an express alternative. Their adequacy is unresolved and cannot be replaced with an invented numeric threshold.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.6.21868146865508f20c8a7f93","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.d4e73857348cf0057e4ea412830c58ebda7e42a99bcfe497390522e5b265aa1e"]}],"rationale":"The setup scenarios are illustrative and vary by client type. Their later transition-period and bound-device qualifications must be retained.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.6.56c0344dc9c6b0cd25353f6b","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.506374b1cbc8d69dd0a0764c9a204966f8baabe0de0b69f1fa505a09de988538"]}],"rationale":"This continuation points to scenarios in subsequent units and cannot independently resolve the second duty or the cross-piece dependencies.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.6.9649c40619de996c464d5669","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.f82edd0d7f506814d14ac19c85617a99b0ed7a4e1a4345daf331ad9c750a2008"]}],"rationale":"The FIDO information reference continues into the next unit outside this batch. Referenced materials are not supplied, so their technical criteria and editions remain unresolved.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"}
  ],
  "coverage_hash":"9e5e2387f4b5ca3f60017b035766228a9d4110d8b4a9d4cfa0e4f28d3d0e5a85",

  "questions":[
    {
      "question_hash":"6ec1d11d48960e45dc0b385876315feab76d59767cf0ae0599eb0bce71433c01",
      "question_id":"gift.question",
      "rationale":"Retained as unresolved: the source concerns internet-trading cybersecurity, not gifts. Neither a prohibition nor its negation is supported. The synthetic reading supplies no executable legal proposal.",
      "status":"UNRESOLVED"
    },
    {
      "question_hash":"abde796f086664b6f9fd6c83ac1aa8418ff4f5eb770663f9e58e0773060a5cce",
      "question_id":"second.duty",
      "rationale":"Retained independently: the second duty is unidentified, and its performance question conflicts with the supplied PROHIBITED classification and gift-related truth meanings. Authentication, monitoring, reporting and other duties cannot silently substitute for it.",
      "status":"UNRESOLVED"
